review_mode: public manifests, reports and source code only; no raw text read, local research computation or join rerun

recommended_existing_release.location_note: This /public/home path is the source-cluster namespace used by run_comparison_join_ks.sbatch; it is not a BU /projectnb path.

employer.scope: company-scrape entity; not verified legal firm or consolidated corporate parent
employer.recommended_use: optional nested comparison only where realized overlap supports it

occupation.source: officially validated current-delivery O*NET occupation code
occupation.scope: current delivered snapshot; not historical occupation evidence

geography.scope: retain missing_state and unmapped_region as distinct branches

time.scope: observation metadata; not advertisement-body publication or text-effective time

recommended_comparison.support_rule: Report realized retained and dropped counts; skip unsupported or sparse contrasts without redefining groups.
recommended_comparison.missing_rule: Preserve occupation missing/unofficial, state missing and region unmapped statuses; do not infer joint complete-case counts from marginal counts.

authoritative_denominators.warning: Candidate, prior eligible and whole-corpus denominators are distinct and must not be combined. The 10,000-row sample T4 not-available status does not supersede verified whole-corpus mapping.

existing_support_evidence.scope: Demonstrates employer-occupation overlap only; it does not establish geography-complete support.

whole_corpus_row_level_materialization.finding: T4 verified all 204,774,035 canonical USA keys against Records and O*NET, but its per-prefix joined_rows tables were temporary. The retained prefix artifacts are cohort and concentration aggregates, not a reusable row-level company/occupation/state/date table.
whole_corpus_row_level_materialization.retention_scope: The 16 prefix summaries preserve aggregate counts by CREATED cohort and separately by company_id, STATE and occupation_major. They do not preserve JOB_HASH-level metadata or joint employer-by-occupation-by-region cells.
whole_corpus_row_level_materialization.implication: Existing full-corpus T4 summaries remain authoritative for marginal mapping and time-risk counts. New row-level within-work comparisons cannot use them as a metadata universe without a separately authorized key reconciliation; until then, joined comparisons remain conditional on the 6,010,975-row candidate release.

official_code_table.use: validate current-snapshot O*NET code before deriving two-digit occupation major

size_evidence.full_source_index_bytes: not reported in the reviewed public manifests
size_evidence.calculation: 121,451 rows x (32 JOB_HASH bytes + 8 RECORD_SOURCE_ROW bytes); excludes Parquet/Arrow overhead and nullable representation
size_evidence.metadata_result_size: unknown until bounded extraction receipt; variable-width COMPANY_ID prevents a defensible exact pre-run byte count
size_evidence.feasibility_boundary: Stage exact first-shard keys by hash prefix and materialize only matching Records/O*NET columns. Do not copy all 16 full index partitions merely because the first-shard keys span all prefixes. Hash, row-count and one-to-many gates must precede deletion of generated staging; source indexes remain untouched.
